$comment: Cases for the advisory caution rules in packages/domain/src/clinical-safety-rules.json (cautionRules). Every rule has at least one case where it fires and one where it does not; `expect` is the exact set of rules that fire for that question and report. Read by packages/domain/test/clinicalSafetyCautions.test.mjs. A pharmacist adding a rule adds its two cases here.

cases.report:
# 证据摘要

ASPREE 试验中阿司匹林增加大出血，USPSTF 2022 不推荐 60 岁及以上人群启用阿司匹林一级预防。

华法林与氯吡格雷联用于冠心病合并房颤患者，可增加大出血风险。
